user.title: Import a plant file
user.description: Paste a Hydronicus plant file, format 2. It describes the whole Plant: its source, pumps, plant loops, and zones with their loops. The new Plant starts with no output armed and Control equipment off, so it commands nothing until you arm its outputs and turn Control equipment on.

data_description.plant_file: The YAML of the plant file. The Export plant file action returns it for an existing Plant.

error.invalid_plant_file: The plant file is not valid. {error}
error.own_entity: The plant file binds an entity that Hydronicus provides, which would feed the Plant back into itself. {error}
error.output_bound_elsewhere: The plant file binds an output that another Plant already controls; an output belongs to one Plant. {error}

abort.already_configured: This Plant is already set up. Remove it first to import its plant file again.
abort.already_in_progress: A setup flow for this Plant is already in progress.

invalid_plant.title: Plant {plant} is not valid
invalid_plant.description: The stored configuration of Plant {plant} is not a valid Plant, so Hydronicus does not run it and commands nothing: {error} This happens when a zone that the Plant still needs is removed, such as the zone of a pump's min-flow loop. Reconfigure the Plant with a plant file that fixes the problem, or remove it and import a corrected plant file.

output_not_responding.title: {plant}: {entity_id} does not respond
output_not_responding.description: Plant {plant} asked {role} {entity_id} to change three times, and the change was never observed. Hydronicus keeps retrying every few minutes. Check that the device is powered and reachable and that its state in Home Assistant follows it. The repair clears automatically once the output shows what the Plant asks for.

outputs_awaiting_confirmation.title: {plant}: outputs awaiting confirmation
outputs_awaiting_confirmation.description: Plant {plant} has outputs that are not armed: {entity_ids}. Hydronicus never commands an output until you confirm it, so the loops that need these outputs do not run, while the rest of the Plant keeps running. Arm the outputs once you have checked that each entity is the device the Plant expects.

missing_binding.title: {plant}: {entity_id} does not exist
missing_binding.description: Plant {plant} binds {entity_id} at {path} in its plant file, but Home Assistant has no such entity. Whatever needs it is blocked: a loop with a missing output does not run, and a zone with a missing required sensor does not call. Restore the entity or change the Plant to bind another one. The repair clears automatically once the entity exists.

missing_area_sensor.title: {plant}: area {area} names a missing sensor
missing_area_sensor.description: A zone of Plant {plant} covers area {area}, whose settings name {entity_id}, but Home Assistant has no such entity, so the area adds no reading. Home Assistant does not follow a renamed entity into the area settings. Open the settings of area {area} and choose the sensor again. The repair clears automatically once the area names an existing sensor.

zone_area_missing.title: {plant}, zone {zone}: missing area {area}
zone_area_missing.description: In Plant {plant}, zone {zone} covers area {area}, which no longer exists in Home Assistant, so the zone gets no reading from it. Remove the area from the zone in its plant file, or create an area named {recreate_name} again: Home Assistant makes a new area's ID from its name, and that name gives the ID {area_id} that the zone covers. You can rename the area afterwards. The repair clears automatically once the zone no longer covers a missing area.

zone_without_temperature_source.title: {plant}, zone {zone}: no temperature sensor
zone_without_temperature_source.description: In Plant {plant}, zone {zone} covers {areas}, but the area settings name no temperature sensor that Hydronicus can follow, so the zone is blocked and does not heat or cool. Choose a temperature sensor in the area settings, or add a temperature sensor to the zone in its plant file. The repair clears automatically once the zone has a temperature sensor.

zone_area_self_feed.title: {plant}, zone {zone}: area {area} names a Hydronicus sensor
zone_area_self_feed.description: In Plant {plant}, zone {zone} covers area {area}, whose settings name {entity_ids}. Hydronicus provides that sensor, and following it would feed the Plant back into itself, so zone {zone} ignores it. Open the settings of area {area} and choose a sensor that measures the room. The repair clears automatically once the area names another sensor.

invalid_plant.message: The stored configuration of Plant {plant} is not a valid Plant: {error}

plant_not_found.message: Config entry {config_entry_id} is not a Hydronicus Plant. Choose a Hydronicus Plant to export.

invalid_target_temperature.message: The zone target temperature {temperature} is not valid. Choose a value between {minimum} °C and {maximum} °C.

export_plant.name: Export plant file
export_plant.description: Returns the plant file of a Hydronicus Plant. Importing it rebuilds the Plant with the same entity IDs.
